v.n: Meet the Teams of Season 39! | the Amazing Race | CBS

eps.t: Sorry Guys, We Used Our Express Pass
eps.o: In Vancouver, host Phil Keoghan surprises racers with the first twist of the season -- for the first time in the show's history there are 13 Express Passes in play.

eps.t: Are Tomatoes Good for Skin Care?
eps.o: Racers travel to Madrid, Spain, where a new alliance emerges, and one team's Express Pass strategy comes with instant regret.
A new advantage is up for grabs in the Moroccan desert, and a fruit-stacking challenge has teams falling apart.
A Moroccan Scramble has teams lost in the confusing alleyways of Marrakesh's Old Town Medina, doing whatever it takes to avoid elimination.

eps.t: A Fine Line Between Confidence and Stupidity
